research_question: Can a separately frozen recovery produce one valid fresh Quant-H0 observation on fx-forward-cross-rate, and does that artifact retain the predeclared public four-decimal mismatch?

setup.result_role: adaptive development target setup recovery only

official_evaluation.interpretation: R2 is the only valid baseline observation in the R1/R2 setup path, but one stochastic Worker execution is not a stable baseline estimate.

public_rounding_audit.rule: Each bid, ask, and mid value must equal the same value rounded to four decimal places.
public_rounding_audit.evidence_scope: Public instruction and fresh R2 Worker artifact only.

r1_r2_setup_accounting.interpretation: This is combined setup-path cost only. R1 was invalid; R2 is the sole valid fresh observation.

retained_conclusion: The separately frozen R2 recovery produced one valid full-score Quant-H0 artifact. Its fresh public FX values had no four-decimal mismatch, so the predeclared branch closed for lack of headroom without an Evolver, Reviewer, proposal, or candidate run.

claim_boundary.supported: One valid stochastic Quant-H0 observation, exact official result and request cost, fresh-artifact public rounding audit, no-headroom terminal decision, combined R1/R2 setup cost, service completion, and cleanup.
claim_boundary.not_supported: A stable Quant-H0 baseline, harness improvement, Evolver or Reviewer effectiveness, candidate quality, benchmark-wide performance, sealed generalization, or main-experiment readiness.
claim_boundary.r1_r2_distinction: R1 remains an invalid setup outcome. R2 is the only valid baseline observation and is not an experimental repeat of a valid R1 result.
